# Exercises for interface-depth.
#
# Each fixture has a module whose surface the request touches. The skill says when to
# change that surface and when to leave it: deepen it by taking a fact away from its
# callers, never widen it for one caller, and leave it alone when a feature only
# reads it. The verifier checks the surface itself: a file's hash, a signature, and
# what a fresh caller has to do before a call works.

# A new report that only reads from store.py. store.py's open, read and close sequence
# invites a tidy-up; the request is a feature, so store.py stays byte for byte.
[leaf-feature] add top_customers(n) to reports.py: the n customers with the most revenue, as (customer_id, revenue_cents) pairs, largest first | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# One caller wants prices without the symbol. A flag on format_price serves it and
# widens the signature every other caller reads; the verifier checks the signature.
[option-for-one-caller] the receipt printer header already shows the currency, so receipt lines should show just the amount, like 12.50 instead of $12.50 | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A caller forgot connect(). Adding the call at that site fixes the crash and leaves
# the obligation with every future caller; the verifier makes a fresh Mailer and sends.
[deepen-callers] notify_shipped crashes with "RuntimeError: not connected" when the nightly job calls it, fix it | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
